crime: Every evening, {WITCH_NAME}'s roommate set a second cup on the rim of the courtyard fountain.

Every evening, {WITCH_NAME} stopped dead in the courtyard doorway. On the brink of stepping out, she watched it all play out first: herself sitting down beside her roommate, and nothing happening, nothing at all. And every evening she still turned back.

When she was eight, she had told her mother she'd pictured holding her baby brother under the bathwater. Her mother lifted him out of the bath and never let her bathe him again. A girl who could picture it, her mother believed, was the kind of girl who would.
One evening her roommate said she would wait on the rim until {WITCH_NAME} drank her cup. "I won't come in until you do."

That evening {WITCH_NAME} froze in the doorway again, on the brink of going out, and watched herself find her: her roommate face down in the basin, the cup sunk beneath her, her own hands on her roommate's back. Too late.
She turned back from the doorway and told no one. All night she lay in their cell beside her roommate's empty bunk bed.
At unlock, the prisoners lifted her roommate out of the basin. The second cup lay sunk beneath her.
In the trial court, {WITCH_NAME} named the cup beneath her before anyone else had. All she would say was, "I saw my hands on her back in the water."
The prisoners ruled that she had gone out and held her under. A girl who had only seen it, they said, would have run to her.

But her roommate had slipped on the wet rim before {WITCH_NAME} ever reached the doorway. She struck her head and fell face down into the basin. The hands {WITCH_NAME} had watched on her back were hauling her up: a rescue already too late, and one she never began.
fields.epitaph: She never stepped out of the doorway: not to kill her, and not to save her.
fields.epithet: The Girl Who Only Watched from the Doorway
execution: The execution stand raised an iron doorway, and she was chained upright inside its frame, her back to an iron backplate. The iron door swung shut on her where she stood on the threshold, pressing her flat against the backplate. It stayed shut with her inside the frame until nothing stirred behind it.

magic.name: Dress Rehearsal
magic.text: On the brink of any act, she watches it play out exactly as it really would, before she has begun.
